This software uses libraries from the FFmpeg project (https://ffmpeg.org/)
under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.

FFmpeg remains a set of independently linked, replaceable shared libraries.
The foundation.audio build disables GPL, nonfree and version3 components.
COPYING.LGPLv2.1 and FFmpeg's LICENSE.md accompany this notice. The exact
source revision, configure options, build configuration and changes.diff are
included for each target. The distribution bundle includes corresponding
FFmpeg source in sources/ffmpeg-source.tar.gz.

When distributing an application, include the notices in its About/licenses
screen, provide the matching source alongside its binary download, and make
sure the application's terms do not prohibit actions permitted by the LGPL,
including debugging modifications to these libraries. Preserve the ability to
use compatible modified FFmpeg libraries. Dynamic linking alone does not
fulfil every distribution obligation. App-store terms and codec patent issues
require a separate assessment for the actual distribution.

FFmpeg's own guidance: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
